hooks.name: block_ignite
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's BlockIgniteEvent)

doc_summary: Fire about to be placed: `native_block_ignite(dimension, player, pos, cause, cancel)` is heard for fire spread, lava, lightning and dispenser flint-and-steel. Set `cancel` to leave the position unchanged. Direct player flint-and-steel/fire-charge placement is not covered. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_ignite@.
